name: 普通翠鸟
aliases: 普通翠鳥 翠鸟 翠鳥
note: 背部有一道明亮的蓝色，胸腹呈橙色。它常停在水边低枝上，朝水面俯冲捕鱼。
source: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: A bright blue stripe runs down the back, and the underparts are orange. This kingfisher often dives for fish from a low branch over the water.
enSource: Royal Society for the Protection of Birds
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: The kingfisher perches on a twig with its back to the camera and its head turned to the left.
imageContext: 翠鸟背向镜头停在细枝上，头转向左边。

name: 戴胜
aliases: 戴勝 欧亚戴胜 歐亞戴勝 Common Hoopoe
note: 长嘴细而向下弯，头顶的羽冠展开时像一把黑边折扇。飞起后，双翼宽阔的黑白横纹尤其醒目。
source: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: The slender bill curves downwards. The crest opens into a black-tipped fan, and broad black and white bars stand out on the wings in flight.
enSource: Royal Society for the Protection of Birds
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: The hoopoe sits on a green rail, with black and white bars visible across its folded wings.
imageContext: 戴胜停在绿色栏杆上，双翅收拢，露出背面的黑白条纹。

name: 白鹡鸰
note: 身体修长，羽色以黑、白、灰为主。它常沿岸边或开阔地来回走动，停下时长尾仍上下摆动。
source: 康奈尔大学鸟类学实验室
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: This slim wagtail is black, white and grey. It walks along shorelines and across open ground, often bobbing its long tail even when it stops.
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: The wagtail stands in profile on a grassy bank beside the water.
imageContext: 白鹡鸰侧身立在水边长着短草的一处土坡上。

name: 绿头鸭
note: 繁殖羽雄鸟头部泛金属绿色，颈部有一道细白环。雌鸟通体褐色杂斑，展翅时也能看到蓝紫色的翼斑。
source: 美国鱼类及野生动物管理局
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: A male in breeding plumage has a glossy green head and a narrow white neck ring. The mottled brown female also shows a blue-violet wing patch when she spreads her wings.
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: This close-up shows a male’s green head and yellow bill.
imageContext: 照片近距离记录了雄鸟的绿色头羽和黄色嘴。

name: 红腹灰雀
aliases: 紅腹灰雀 歐亞鷽 欧亚鸴
note: 成鸟的头顶像扣着一顶黑帽，嘴短而厚。飞起时留意背后，黑尾上方有一块清楚的白腰。
source: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: Adults have a black cap and a short, thick bill. In flight, a white rump shows just above the black tail.
enSource: Royal Society for the Protection of Birds
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: The bullfinch is perched side-on, showing its black cap and pink underparts.
imageContext: 灰雀侧身停在枝头，可以看到黑色的头顶和粉红色胸腹。

name: 白鹭
aliases: 白鷺 小白鹭 小白鷺
note: 羽毛通体白色，嘴细长而黑。它抬脚涉水时，黄色的脚趾与黑色小腿形成鲜明对比。
source: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: This white egret has a long, slender black bill. As it steps through water, its yellow toes stand out against its black legs.
enSource: Royal Society for the Protection of Birds
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: The egret lowers its head as it wades, with its reflection visible below.
imageContext: 白鹭在水中俯下头，水面映出它的身影。

name: 鸳鸯
note: 雄鸟在繁殖季有一对橙色的帆状羽毛。雌鸟通体灰褐，眼周的浅色环向后延伸。
source: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: A male in breeding plumage has two orange, sail-shaped feathers on his back. The grey-brown female has a pale eye-ring that tapers into a line behind the eye.
enSource: Royal Society for the Protection of Birds
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: A pair stands side by side at the water’s edge, the male on the left and the female on the right.
imageContext: 一对鸳鸯并排站在岸边，雄鸟在左，雌鸟在右。

name: 家燕
note: 成鸟额头和喉部呈栗红色，尾羽分叉。飞行时可以留意细长的外侧尾羽。
source: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: Adults have a chestnut forehead and throat and a forked tail. In flight, look for the long, narrow outer tail feathers.
enSource: Royal Society for the Protection of Birds
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: The swallow is perched on bare ground with its dark tail extending behind it.
imageContext: 家燕停在裸露的土面上，黑色尾羽向后伸出。

name: 苍鹭
note: 体羽以灰色为主，长颈、长腿，常在浅水中静候猎物。飞起时，颈部会缩成弯曲的形状。
source: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: This mostly grey heron has a long neck and long legs. It often waits motionless for prey in shallow water and flies with its neck folded back.
enSource: Royal Society for the Protection of Birds
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: The heron stands side-on on a rock in shallow water.
imageContext: 苍鹭站在浅水中的石面上，侧向镜头。

name: 树麻雀
aliases: 树麻雀 麻雀 樹麻雀
note: 栗色头顶和白颊上的黑斑是辨识要点。雌雄外形相近。
source: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: A chestnut crown and a black spot on each white cheek help identify this sparrow. Males and females look alike.
enSource: Royal Society for the Protection of Birds
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: The sparrow perches on a pale ledge, its dark cheek patch clearly visible.
imageContext: 树麻雀侧身停在浅色台面上，深色颊斑清晰可见。

name: 小䴙䴘
aliases: 小鸊鷉 小鸊鷈 小辟鹈 小鷿鷈
note: 小型潜水鸟，短嘴，身形圆，尾部很短。繁殖羽的颊和颈侧呈栗色，嘴角可见浅色斑。
source: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: This small diving bird has a rounded body, a short bill and a very short tail. In breeding plumage its cheeks and the sides of its neck are chestnut, with a pale patch at the base of the bill.
enSource: Royal Society for the Protection of Birds
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: The grebe swims across still water, its chestnut cheek reflected below.
imageContext: 小䴙䴘从平静的水面游过，栗色的脸颊映在水中。

name: 欧亚鸲
aliases: 歐亞鴝 知更鸟 知更鳥 欧亚知更鸟
note: 成鸟脸部和前胸为橙红色，背部偏褐。幼鸟带有斑点，还未长出橙红色胸羽。
source: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会
changes: 保留完整画幅，按原比例转为 WebP。详情图长边 1920 像素，卡片预览长边 480 像素。
enNote: Adults have an orange-red face and breast and a brownish back. Juveniles are speckled and have yet to grow the orange-red breast feathers.
enSource: Royal Society for the Protection of Birds
enChanges: Full-frame WebP versions at the original aspect ratio, with a 1920-pixel long edge for the record and 480 pixels for the card.
enImageContext: The robin stands on a slender branch in profile, its orange-red breast facing left.
imageContext: 欧亚鸲侧身立在细枝上，橙红色的前胸朝向左边。
